verdict.rationale: Cursor's own MCP support documents connecting the agent to external tools and data sources. Integrations are installed from a marketplace with OAuth sign-in or configured as custom servers in JSON, and Cloud Agents also accept MCP servers. Slack and Linear integrations are documented, but the Slack evidence covers triggering and collaborating with the agent rather than pulling Slack content in as context. Jira and Google Drive are never named. Missing for 10: documented Jira and Google Drive connectors, evidence that Slack can serve as a context source for the agent, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context

citations.quote: Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables Cursor to connect to external tools and data sources.
Click "Add to Cursor" on a marketplace entry to install it and authenticate with OAuth.
Configure custom MCP servers with a JSON file
Work with GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket, JetBrains, Slack, Linear, and more
